title: HTTP/3 Low-Level Malformed Sequence Test Work Item
summary: Add deterministic low-level HTTP/3 malformed sequence tests with h3i examples, expected error mapping, and automated pass/fail checks.
planned_changes:
- Add documentation with h3i-style examples and expected outcomes.
- Add a custom low-level HTTP/3 test client in the test project.
- Add automated tests for malformed frame order, invalid frame length, invalid headers, duplicate control streams, server-initiated bidirectional streams, and unknown/reserved frame behavior.
- Add requirement-home trace proof for the new RFC 9114 protocol-owned test lane.
out_of_scope: pinning and running live h3i in CI
fixing protocol gaps discovered by these tests
claiming complete RFC 9114 or RFC 9204 support
verification_plan: Run solution build, run the low-level HTTP/3 malformed sequence tests, run the requirement-home tests for REQ-QUIC-RFC9114-S4-0001, and run core SpecTrace validation.
